initiative.title: First-run onboarding
initiative.summary: A solo developer who clones plan-viewer from GitHub ends with a working workspace of their own without hand-holding; the demo-first path is reconsidered.
initiative.next_action: Build M1-M3; M4 waits for TASK-0040 Setup page

sources.anchor: Byron 2026-11-18 dictation: demo is not helping people
Try it / Use it with your own plans

claims.statement: A new user ends the first run in their own workspace, not sample data.
The demo-first path does not help new users and should be reconsidered.
Audience: solo developers using Claude or Codex who clone from GitHub.
Integration setup goes through agent helpers, not an in-app wizard.
Build on the TASK-0039 layout; no old-layout support.
npm run demo becomes a contributor-only script named dev:demo; README no longer leads with it.
The workspace lives in a sibling folder beside the plan-viewer clone.
Setup is agent-first: README gives a prompt to paste into Claude or Codex in the clone.
An empty workspace opens on a getting-started page whose items copy agent prompts or queue Up next notes.
Getting started is the top section of the TASK-0040 Settings page while the workspace is new; it shrinks to a chip once a daily plan and a task exist.
The first-run agent runs init, starts the viewer, interviews the user briefly, and writes today plan plus one real task.
init creates no package.json; it sets core.hooksPath to the viewer hooks and writes the viewer path into the workspace AGENTS.md.
README leads with pitch, one screenshot, then a one-line agent prompt pointing at docs/setup.md.
Build the parts independent of TASK-0039/0040 now; the getting-started section waits for the settings page.

shape.appetite: Small stack: plan PR, three build PRs now, one after TASK-0040
shape.recommended_shape: Agent-first setup via docs/setup.md, init without package.json, demo renamed dev:demo, Getting started section on Setup page
success_moves: Drop package.json so no package manager is a setup step
setup.md names no folder paths so it survives the layout change
Getting started joins the Setup page instead of a new page

first_proof.decision_rule: Any step needing knowledge outside setup.md or workspace AGENTS.md gets added before the README points at it
